title: Full list, get, patch and slug redirects from server code through ctx.backend
why: Server functions can filter, sort, paginate, include relations, patch records and resolve old slugs with the same contract as the HTTP API, and hand 422 field errors back to a form.
changelog: `ctx.backend` speaks the full HTTP list contract from server code

adopt.snippet:
<meta server>
export async function recent(ctx) {
  return ctx.backend.list('posts', { sort: '-createdAt', limit: 10 })
}
